correctness.rationale: At the 12 normalized cuboctahedron vertices, degree<=2 spherical harmonic restriction has evaluation matrix E of size 12x9 and rank9. A displayed rank3 integer 12x3 B has B^T E=0; hence it spans the complete left kernel. The six antipodal row-pairs of B are signed/parallel tetrahedral potential differences t_i-t_j, so erased-row rank B_T=4-c(G_T) by graphic incidence. The retained rank is (12-|T|)-(3-rank B_T)=13-|T|-c(G_T) for every subset, with empty/full boundaries included. Independent finite-field exact matrix rank checks across every one of the 4096 erasures, all 27 nullspace products and the complete rank census agree; 60/66 2-erasure and 128/220 3-erasure choices are recoverable. The abstract Gale/graphic identity also proves the finite exhaustive formula, not merely a log output.
